# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.
* [ Healthcare Insights ][18]
  
  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance
  healthcare.
* [ People of Baxter ][19]
  
  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.
* [ Community Engagement ][20]
  
  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

[All Early Phase Clinical Services][140]

## At the Speed of Science

Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories in Lincoln, NE and Zurich, Switzerland are equipped with the
latest technologies for PK, immunogenicity, and biomarker assays to provide regulated support at all
phases of drug development.

[Learn More][147]

## Bioanalytical Sciences

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug
developers from pre-clinical through late-stage clinical testing. Learn how our experienced
scientific teams can provide custom, phase-appropriate bioanalytical solutions for your program.

[Bioanalytical Sciences Overview][148]

CLINICAL RESEARCH SPOTLIGHT

## The Future of Pharmacy

We’ve got our eyes set on the future. We’re taking research higher, discoveries further, and
translating science into medicine day by day.

[Learn More][155]

## Therapeutic Expertise Areas

### Focused on Strong Science and Flawless Execution

Between our comprehensive services and decades of therapeutic experience, we have the expertise to
handle every aspect of your product’s early development—no matter the type of drug or clinical
trial. These are some of the many specialties we’ve cultivated over the years, to provide fast,
innovative solutions for your drug’s development.

## What Sets Us Apart

[AGILE ICON][AGILE ICON]

#### AGILE

Speed is part of our name. We optimize our studies for speed and efficiency at every stage, to
generate actionable data faster than our competitors.

[EXPERIENCED ICON][EXPERIENCED ICON]

#### EXPERIENCED

Our 50+ years of experience conducting 6,000+ studies ensures the collection of quality data through
efficient and effective study designs.

[GLOBAL ICON][GLOBAL ICON]

#### GLOBAL

With facilities across North America, Europe, and Asia, in 30 countries worldwide, we conduct trials
with the right patients, in the right places, to get the data you need.

[INNOVATIVE ICON][INNOVATIVE ICON]

#### INNOVATIVE

From data acquisition strategies to advanced facilities, we lead the way in leveraging new
technology to provide faster, more accurate data, at less cost.

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories in Lincoln, NE and Zurich, Switzerland are equipped with the

phases of drug development.

## Bioanalytical Sciences

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug
developers from pre-clinical through late-stage clinical testing. Learn how our experienced
scientific teams can provide custom, phase-appropriate bioanalytical solutions for your program.

Between our comprehensive services and decades of therapeutic experience, we have the expertise to

### Vision

We strive to transform Fresenius Kabi in the decade to come. We are committed to increase
efficiencies in the therapy and care of patients and improve access to high-quality healthcare
around the globe.

[healthcare professionals in action]

patients. With our passion and expertise, we touch the lives of almost 450 million people every
year, each one representing the importance of our work.

and healthcare professionals goes hand in hand with responsible and ethical management.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

designed to help more patients benefit from the body’s own defenses against cancer.

Target tumors that have resisted earlier immunotherapies
Deliver deeper and longer-lasting responses
Offer a safer, more effective path forward for patients

pillars that take cancer patients from uncertainty to clarity."

### Comprehensive Medical Record Review

We carefully review your pathology reports, imaging scans, molecular test results, previous
treatments, and current clinical condition to understand your case as a whole. This comprehensive
assessment provides the foundation for identifying suitable treatment options and determining the
most appropriate next steps.

### Expert Second Opinion

We connect your case with experienced oncologists and multidisciplinary specialists for an
independent medical opinion. The second-opinion process can help confirm the diagnosis, review the

important treatment decision is made.

### Personalized Treatment Guidance

stage, previous treatments, and molecular markers. These may include CAR T-cell therapy, TIL
therapy, gene therapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy, proton therapy, and other emerging
treatments. We translate complex medical information into clear and actionable guidance.

### Specialist and Hospital Navigation

CancerFax helps match patients with appropriate specialists, hospitals, and cancer centers based on
their specific medical needs. We evaluate clinical expertise, treatment availability, institutional
capabilities, expected timelines, and other practical considerations so patients can make informed
decisions about where to seek treatment.

### Clinical Trial Matching and Access

We identify relevant clinical trials for patients with advanced, relapsed, rare, or
difficult-to-treat cancers, and we have particular expertise in accessing trials in China, India,
and the USA. Our team conducts an initial eligibility review, communicates with trial centers, and
guides patients through screening, documentation, and enrollment.

### End-to-End Care Coordination

From preparing medical documents and communicating with hospitals to appointment scheduling, visa
assistance, travel planning, admission support, and continuity of care, CancerFax coordinates the
complete treatment journey. This allows patients and their families to focus on treatment while we
manage the clinical and logistical details.

Our Difference

## Why Patients Choose CancerFax?

"We don't book hospitals. We walk beside families navigating the hardest decisions of their lives,
with compassion, care, and commitment that doesn't waver."

### Advanced Treatment Focus

Specialized expertise in therapies that are often inaccessible locally, cell therapy, gene therapy,
precision oncology, and clinical trials.

### Cross-Border Coordination

Comprehensive support across international treatment destinations, case review, admissions, hospital
communication, and logistics.

### Hospital & Doctor Navigation

Guidance on the right institutions, specialist matching based on diagnosis, and center selection
tailored to clinical complexity.

### Clinical Trial Awareness

Support in identifying and exploring clinical trial options when appropriate, including
mutation-specific and late-line investigational pathways.

### Compassionate Support

Human guidance for patients and families navigating difficult decisions, with emphasis on clarity,
honesty, and realistic, informed hope.

### Independent Second Opinions

Access trusted second opinions from global cancer specialists, ensuring every diagnosis, treatment
plan, and decision is reviewed with expert clarity.

Our Process

## How It Works?

A clear, structured, and compassionate four-step process designed to bring order to a difficult
moment.

1

### Share Your Reports

Upload your pathology reports, imaging results, treatment history, and any relevant clinical
documents securely through our platform.

2

### Our Team Reviews Your Case

CancerFax specialists conduct a thorough clinical review of your diagnosis, disease stage,
biomarkers, and treatment history.

3

### Identify Treatment Pathways

We explore suitable advanced therapies, clinical trial opportunities, and international treatment
options relevant to your case.

4

### Coordinate Next Steps

We help arrange specialist consultations, hospital admissions, additional diagnostics, logistics,
and ongoing care coordination.

### CAR-T Cell Therapy

CAR-T cell therapy is an adoptive cell therapy that genetically engineers a patient's own T-cells to
express a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) — a synthetic protein that directs T-cells to recognize
and destroy cancer cells. First conceptualized by Zelig Eshhar in the late 1980s and brought to
clinical success by Carl June's group at Penn in 2010–2012, the first FDA approval (Kymriah for
pediatric B-ALL) followed in August 2017.

Learn more →][56][Treatment

### Tumor Therapeutic Vaccines

Tumor therapeutic vaccines are cancer immunotherapy treatments given to patients who already have
cancer, not to prevent it. They stimulate the immune system to recognize tumor-specific antigens,
mount a targeted T-cell response, and destroy cancer cells throughout the body.

Learn more →][57][Treatment

### CAR NK Cell Therapy

To grasp the reason behind the significant leap of CAR NK cell therapy over CAR-T cell therapy, it
is first necessary to understand the nature of natural killer cells and their fundamental
distinction from the T-cells that are used in CAR-T cell therapy. The distinction between the two
types of cells is clinically significant in terms of safety, ease of access, and the types of cancer
targeted.

## What does CancerFax do?

"Advanced cancer treatment guidance, clinical trial matching, and care coordination are three
pillars that take cancer patients from uncertainty to clarity."

### Comprehensive Medical Record Review

We carefully review your pathology reports, imaging scans, molecular test results, previous
treatments, and current clinical condition to understand your case as a whole. This comprehensive
assessment provides the foundation for identifying suitable treatment options and determining the
most appropriate next steps.

### Expert Second Opinion

We connect your case with experienced oncologists and multidisciplinary specialists for an
independent medical opinion. The second-opinion process can help confirm the diagnosis, review the
current treatment plan, identify overlooked options, and provide greater confidence before an
important treatment decision is made.

### Personalized Treatment Guidance

We help you understand which advanced treatment options may be relevant to your diagnosis, disease
stage, previous treatments, and molecular markers. These may include CAR T-cell therapy, TIL
therapy, gene therapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy, proton therapy, and other emerging
treatments. We translate complex medical information into clear and actionable guidance.

### Specialist and Hospital Navigation

CancerFax helps match patients with appropriate specialists, hospitals, and cancer centers based on
their specific medical needs. We evaluate clinical expertise, treatment availability, institutional
capabilities, expected timelines, and other practical considerations so patients can make informed
decisions about where to seek treatment.

### Clinical Trial Matching and Access

We identify relevant clinical trials for patients with advanced, relapsed, rare, or
difficult-to-treat cancers, and we have particular expertise in accessing trials in China, India,
and the USA. Our team conducts an initial eligibility review, communicates with trial centers, and
guides patients through screening, documentation, and enrollment.

### End-to-End Care Coordination

From preparing medical documents and communicating with hospitals to appointment scheduling, visa
assistance, travel planning, admission support, and continuity of care, CancerFax coordinates the
complete treatment journey. This allows patients and their families to focus on treatment while we
manage the clinical and logistical details.

Our Difference

## Why Patients Choose CancerFax?

"We don't book hospitals. We walk beside families navigating the hardest decisions of their lives,
with compassion, care, and commitment that doesn't waver."

### Advanced Treatment Focus

Specialized expertise in therapies that are often inaccessible locally, cell therapy, gene therapy,
precision oncology, and clinical trials.

### Cross-Border Coordination

Comprehensive support across international treatment destinations, case review, admissions, hospital
communication, and logistics.

### Hospital & Doctor Navigation

Guidance on the right institutions, specialist matching based on diagnosis, and center selection
tailored to clinical complexity.

### Clinical Trial Awareness

Support in identifying and exploring clinical trial options when appropriate, including
mutation-specific and late-line investigational pathways.

### Compassionate Support

Human guidance for patients and families navigating difficult decisions, with emphasis on clarity,
honesty, and realistic, informed hope.

### Independent Second Opinions

Access trusted second opinions from global cancer specialists, ensuring every diagnosis, treatment
plan, and decision is reviewed with expert clarity.

Our Process

## How It Works?

A clear, structured, and compassionate four-step process designed to bring order to a difficult
moment.

1

### Share Your Reports

Upload your pathology reports, imaging results, treatment history, and any relevant clinical
documents securely through our platform.

2

### Our Team Reviews Your Case

CancerFax specialists conduct a thorough clinical review of your diagnosis, disease stage,
biomarkers, and treatment history.

3

### Identify Treatment Pathways

We explore suitable advanced therapies, clinical trial opportunities, and international treatment
options relevant to your case.

4

### Coordinate Next Steps

We help arrange specialist consultations, hospital admissions, additional diagnostics, logistics,
and ongoing care coordination.

## Featured Treatment Areas

We cover the full landscape of advanced oncology, from cell therapies to precision radiation and
clinical trials.

[Treatment

### CAR-T Cell Therapy

CAR-T cell therapy is an adoptive cell therapy that genetically engineers a patient's own T-cells to
express a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) — a synthetic protein that directs T-cells to recognize
and destroy cancer cells. First conceptualized by Zelig Eshhar in the late 1980s and brought to
clinical success by Carl June's group at Penn in 2010–2012, the first FDA approval (Kymriah for
pediatric B-ALL) followed in August 2017.

Learn more →][56][Treatment

### Tumor Therapeutic Vaccines

Tumor therapeutic vaccines are cancer immunotherapy treatments given to patients who already have
cancer, not to prevent it. They stimulate the immune system to recognize tumor-specific antigens,
mount a targeted T-cell response, and destroy cancer cells throughout the body.

Learn more →][57][Treatment

### CAR NK Cell Therapy

To grasp the reason behind the significant leap of CAR NK cell therapy over CAR-T cell therapy, it
is first necessary to understand the nature of natural killer cells and their fundamental
distinction from the T-cells that are used in CAR-T cell therapy. The distinction between the two
types of cells is clinically significant in terms of safety, ease of access, and the types of cancer
targeted.

# Our Expertise in Cancer Research Drives Our Excellence in Patient Care.

At Dana-Farber, we specialize in the science of your type of cancer and everything you need to get
your life back.

[ Why Choose Dana-Farber ][126]

## Building the Future of Cancer Care

Our patient-centered approach is grounded in a singular focus — cancer care. That focus has driven
us throughout our history, and it has resulted in plans for a new dedicated inpatient cancer
hospital, and a transformative clinical collaboration.

[ Our Vision for Cancer Care ][133]

## Discover the Dana-Farber Difference

[physician-and-patient-stethoscope-600x368.webp]
[

Exceptional Clinical Care

][134]

At Dana-Farber, world-renowned specialists provide personalized cancer care informed by the latest
advances in treatment. From diagnosis through survivorship, we partner with patients and families to
deliver exceptional care and support every step of the way.

[researcher-writing-on-glass556x381.jpg]
[

Groundbreaking Research

][135]

Dana-Farber Cancer Institute remains true to Dr. Sidney Farber's vision of a cancer center that is
as dedicated to discoveries in cancer research as it is to delivering compassionate,
patient-centered care. Discoveries made by Dana-Farber researchers today become tomorrow’s
breakthrough treatments.

# Our Expertise in Cancer Research Drives Our Excellence in Patient Care.

At Dana-Farber, we specialize in the science of your type of cancer and everything you need to get
your life back.

[ Why Choose Dana-Farber ][126]

* [ Appointments and Second Opinions ][127]
* [ Dana-Farber Locations ][128]
* [ International Patients ][129]
* [ Find Your Cancer Type ][130]
* [ Search Clinical Trials ][131]
* [ Plan Your Visit ][132]

[fch-rendering-6-2025-6-1225x689.jpg]

## Building the Future of Cancer Care

Our patient-centered approach is grounded in a singular focus — cancer care. That focus has driven
us throughout our history, and it has resulted in plans for a new dedicated inpatient cancer
hospital, and a transformative clinical collaboration.

[ Our Vision for Cancer Care ][133]

## Discover the Dana-Farber Difference

[physician-and-patient-stethoscope-600x368.webp]
[

Exceptional Clinical Care

][134]

At Dana-Farber, world-renowned specialists provide personalized cancer care informed by the latest
advances in treatment. From diagnosis through survivorship, we partner with patients and families to
deliver exceptional care and support every step of the way.

[researcher-writing-on-glass556x381.jpg]
[

Groundbreaking Research

][135]

Dana-Farber Cancer Institute remains true to Dr. Sidney Farber's vision of a cancer center that is
as dedicated to discoveries in cancer research as it is to delivering compassionate,
patient-centered care. Discoveries made by Dana-Farber researchers today become tomorrow’s
breakthrough treatments.

## Everything we do is centered around you.
* [ Your Care Team ][136]
* [ Specialized Centers ][137]
* [ Support Services ][138]
* [ Counseling ][139]
* [ Pharmacy ][140]
* [ Integrative Therapies ][141]

[naheem-tahir-at-foxboro.jpg]

## Meet Our Specialists

At Dana-Farber, you not only get a cancer specialist, but you also get a specialist in your
particular type of cancer.

[ Find a Doctor ][142]

# Powerful
# & Precise Radiation.

[learn more ][37]

Cancer Treatment That Prioritizes
Your Quality of Life

## How Proton Therapy Works

Proton therapy is an extremely precise form of radiation treatment.

It uses positively charged particles to deliver radiation that matches the size, shape, and depth of
a tumor down to the millimeter. Unlike traditional radiation, protons stop at the tumor, reducing
exposure to surrounding healthy tissue. This may lower the risk of side effects and help patients
return to life sooner.

[ Learn More ][38]

## Advanced Proton Therapy Technology

Emory Proton Therapy Center uses pencil beam scanning, the most advanced form of proton therapy
available in Georgia. This technique “paints” the tumor with radiation spot by spot, making it ideal
for irregular shapes or tumors near sensitive areas. Every treatment room features leading-edge
imaging, including MRI and cone-beam CT, for precise tumor targeting and monitoring.

[ Learn More ][39]

  The Impact Factor measures the average number of citations received in a particular year by papers
  published in the journal during the two preceding years.
  Journal Citation Reports 2025 (Clarivate Analytics, 2026)
* 12
  CiteScore
  CiteScore measures the average citations received per peer-reviewed document. CiteScore values are
  based on citation counts in a range of four years to peer-reviewed documents published in the same
  four calendar years, divided by the number of these documents in these same four years.
  2025 CiteScore © 2026 Elsevier B.V.

## About

### ESMO Open

[[Cover Image - ESMO Open, Volume 11, Issue 7]][78]

*ESMO Open* is the European Society for Medical Oncology's online-only, peer-reviewed open access
journal, dedicated to publishing high-quality medical research and educational content from all
disciplines of oncology, with a focus on innovative clinical and translational cancer research. The
Journal aims to maximize industry networks to curate and disseminate preclinical or translational
data. We hope to bridge the gap between basic research and clinical applications, facilitating the
translation of groundbreaking discoveries into tangible advancements in cancer care. Our platform
will serve as a catalyst for innovation, nurturing the dialogue between academia, industry, and
clinical practice.

### ESMO

[ESMO  Opens in new window][79]   is the European Society for Medical Oncology. Representing over
50,000 members globally, ESMO is a reference for oncology education and information.

Founded in 1975, ESMO has European roots with a global reach. Home for all oncology stakeholders,
ESMO connects professionals with diverse expertise and experience. Its education and information
resources support an integrated multi-professional approach to cancer care, from a medical oncology
perspective.

ESMO seeks to erase boundaries in cancer care, whether between countries or specialities, and pursue
its mission across oncology, worldwide.

[ESMO Guidelines Opens in new window][80]

## About

### ESMO Open

[[Cover Image - ESMO Open, Volume 11, Issue 7]][78]

*ESMO Open* is the European Society for Medical Oncology's online-only, peer-reviewed open access
journal, dedicated to publishing high-quality medical research and educational content from all
disciplines of oncology, with a focus on innovative clinical and translational cancer research. The
Journal aims to maximize industry networks to curate and disseminate preclinical or translational
data. We hope to bridge the gap between basic research and clinical applications, facilitating the
translation of groundbreaking discoveries into tangible advancements in cancer care. Our platform
will serve as a catalyst for innovation, nurturing the dialogue between academia, industry, and
clinical practice.

### ESMO

[ESMO  Opens in new window][79]   is the European Society for Medical Oncology. Representing over
50,000 members globally, ESMO is a reference for oncology education and information.

Founded in 1975, ESMO has European roots with a global reach. Home for all oncology stakeholders,
ESMO connects professionals with diverse expertise and experience. Its education and information
resources support an integrated multi-professional approach to cancer care, from a medical oncology
perspective.

ESMO seeks to erase boundaries in cancer care, whether between countries or specialities, and pursue
its mission across oncology, worldwide.

[ESMO Guidelines Opens in new window][80]

an effective cancer treatment alternative

Less risk. Higher quality of life during treatment.

Protons can be precisely controlled, allowing our physicians to closely target your tumor and
deliver powerful doses of radiation with:
* Less damage to healthy tissue
* Fewer side effects
* Low risk of secondary cancers
* Better quality of life during and after treatment

The UF Health Proton Therapy Institute is the first and leading proton therapy facility in the
Southeast, and for the last 19+ years, our expert physicians have treated more than 13,000 patients
and over 20 cancer types, helping patients around the world achieve excellent success and quality of

Less risk. Higher quality of life during treatment.

Protons can be precisely controlled, allowing our physicians to closely target your tumor and
deliver powerful doses of radiation with:
* Less damage to healthy tissue
* Fewer side effects
* Low risk of secondary cancers
* Better quality of life during and after treatment

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.

## Non-Toxic Therapies That Target Cancer Cells

Patient-Centered Integrative & Alternative Cancer Treatment Center

Take the first step toward integrative cancer care. Contact Hope4Cancer to schedule a complimentary
consultation and receive a personalized treatment plan tailored to individual diagnosis and goals.

Play Video [Dr. Tony Jimenez speaking with a doctor at Hope4Cancer] Your browser does not support
the video tag.

Hope4Cancer Treatment Centers provide personalized, non-toxic alternative cancer treatment at two
world-class facilities in Cancun and Playas de Tijuana, Mexico. Since 2000, the board-certified
medical team led by founder Antonio Jimenez, M.D., N.D., has treated thousands of patients from over
100 countries, offering more integrative cancer therapies under one roof than any other center in
the world.

Integrative Cancer Treatment Rooted in the 7 Key Principles

Every treatment program at Hope4Cancer follows the 7 Key Principles of Cancer Therapy, a
comprehensive clinical framework that addresses cancer from multiple angles simultaneously. Rather
than focusing solely on the tumor, this approach treats the whole person, targeting cancer cells
with non-toxic therapies while simultaneously restoring immune function, optimizing nutrition,
supporting detoxification, rebalancing the microbiome, providing oxygenation therapy, and addressing
emotional and spiritual well-being.

Non-Toxic Therapies That Target Cancer Cells

The Hope4Cancer protocol includes Sono-Photo Dynamic Therapy (SPDT), Photo Dynamic Therapy Plus
using advanced laser technology, bio-immunotherapy, hyperthermia, pulsed electromagnetic field
therapy (PEMF), ozone therapy, IV nutrient infusions, and many additional modalities. Each therapy
is selected for its ability to selectively target malignant cells while leaving healthy tissue
unharmed, avoiding the debilitating side effects commonly associated with conventional chemotherapy
and radiation.

Immune System Restoration and Support

The proprietary Sunivera Bio-Immunotherapy Protocol combines a macrophage activating factor (MAF)
with synergistic nutraceuticals to modulate both innate and adaptive immune responses. This
protocol, developed from 25 years of research at leading institutions, helps restore the immune
system's natural cancer-fighting capabilities, which are often compromised by the disease itself or
by prior conventional treatments.

World-Class Cancer Treatment Centers

Hope4Cancer operates two strategically located treatment centers on the Pacific and Caribbean coasts
of Mexico. Both facilities provide access to cutting-edge therapies and technologies in
healing-focused environments.

Hope4Cancer Treatment Centers provide personalized, non-toxic alternative cancer treatment at two
world-class facilities in Cancun and Playas de Tijuana, Mexico. Since 2000, the board-certified
medical team led by founder Antonio Jimenez, M.D., N.D., has treated thousands of patients from over
100 countries, offering more integrative cancer therapies under one roof than any other center in
the world.

Integrative Cancer Treatment Rooted in the 7 Key Principles

Every treatment program at Hope4Cancer follows the 7 Key Principles of Cancer Therapy, a
comprehensive clinical framework that addresses cancer from multiple angles simultaneously. Rather
than focusing solely on the tumor, this approach treats the whole person, targeting cancer cells
with non-toxic therapies while simultaneously restoring immune function, optimizing nutrition,
supporting detoxification, rebalancing the microbiome, providing oxygenation therapy, and addressing
emotional and spiritual well-being.

Non-Toxic Therapies That Target Cancer Cells

The Hope4Cancer protocol includes Sono-Photo Dynamic Therapy (SPDT), Photo Dynamic Therapy Plus
using advanced laser technology, bio-immunotherapy, hyperthermia, pulsed electromagnetic field
therapy (PEMF), ozone therapy, IV nutrient infusions, and many additional modalities. Each therapy
is selected for its ability to selectively target malignant cells while leaving healthy tissue
unharmed, avoiding the debilitating side effects commonly associated with conventional chemotherapy
and radiation.

Immune System Restoration and Support

The proprietary Sunivera Bio-Immunotherapy Protocol combines a macrophage activating factor (MAF)
with synergistic nutraceuticals to modulate both innate and adaptive immune responses. This
protocol, developed from 25 years of research at leading institutions, helps restore the immune
system's natural cancer-fighting capabilities, which are often compromised by the disease itself or
by prior conventional treatments.

World-Class Cancer Treatment Centers

Hope4Cancer operates two strategically located treatment centers on the Pacific and Caribbean coasts
of Mexico. Both facilities provide access to cutting-edge therapies and technologies in
healing-focused environments.

## Hope4Cancer Different

with supplies, and follow-up visits. The medical team designs each plan individually based on the
patient's diagnosis, cancer type, stage, and personal health goals.

# Pioneering a Transformational Approach to Treating Cancer

Iovance Biotherapeutics is pioneering a transformational approach to treating cancer by harnessing
the ability of the human immune system to recognize and attack diverse cancer cells in each patient.

[About Iovance Biotherapeutics][41]

## TIL therapy

Tumor infiltrating lymphocytes (TIL) are naturally occurring immune cells that fight cancer. TIL are
on constant surveillance to recognize, attack and kill cancer cells. When cancer invades and
prevails, the TIL are unable to perform their intended function. Investigational TIL therapies are
designed to reinvigorate a patient’s TIL to fight cancer. A patient’s naturally occurring TIL are
collected and grown outside the body so they can be administered back to the patient as a one-time
treatment. Once inside the body, **Iovance TIL therapy deploys billions of personalized,
patient-specific TIL to recognize and target diverse cancer cells.**

TIL monotherapy and TIL combination therapies are being investigated in clinical studies in multiple
advanced solid tumor cancers.

 

[Learn more about TIL therapy][42]

[View our scientific publications & presentations][43]

## Now Enrolling

[ Advanced Front-line Melanoma (TILVANCE-301) ][44] [ Advanced Second-line NSCLC (IOV-LUN-202) ][45]
[ Advanced Endometrial Cancer (IOV-END-201) ][46]

## Latest news

[ View All News Releases ][47]

## Clinical platforms

Our T-cell-based immunotherapy technology platforms are potentially applicable to many solid tumor
types. Each platform is focused on leveraging patient-specific cells to recognize and attack diverse
cancer cells that are unique to each patient. Unlike targeted cell therapies that act on shared
antigen targets common to certain tumors, our polyclonal T cells are personalized therapies designed
to target a variety of neoantigens (new proteins generated by tumor mutations) that are unique to
the patient or tumor.

We are currently investigating TIL therapy in clinical trials in multiple advanced solid tumor
cancers. We are also advancing genetically modified TIL therapies as a next-generation approach for
solid tumor cancers.

[View our clinical pipeline][48]

## Iovance Cell Therapy Center (*i*CTC)

Our TIL therapy is manufactured at our state-of-the-art, 136,000–square-foot Cell Therapy Center,
located in Philadelphia, PA, using proprietary good manufacturing practices (GMP).

[Learn more about the *i*CTC][49]

# Why Choose UT MD Anderson

Every day, people like you choose UT MD Anderson for cancer treatment. But it’s more than our
decades of experience, top national rankings and leadership in cancer prevention that set us apart.
It goes beyond our groundbreaking research and innovative clinical care that provide new therapies
years before they become standard in the community. It’s because we put all of our focus on you.

Every day, people like you choose UT MD Anderson for cancer treatment. But it’s more than our
decades of experience, top national rankings and leadership in cancer prevention that set us apart.
It goes beyond our groundbreaking research and innovative clinical care that provide new therapies
years before they become standard in the community. It’s because we put all of our focus on you.

## Top-Rated Hospital with Advanced European Healthcare Standards

Medicover Hospitals is one of the leading hospital chains in India, delivering advanced healthcare
aligned with international and European standards. Renowned for clinical excellence, cutting-edge
technology, and a patient-centric approach, the group offers a comprehensive range of healthcare
services. Its extensive network includes clinics, hospitals, specialty care centers, fertility
units, and diagnostic laboratories. Medicover Hospitals has established a strong and trusted
presence across multiple states, ensuring accessible and high-quality care for diverse patient
needs.

In Telangana, it stands among the [**Best hospitals in Hyderabad**][280], with facilities in
[**Financial District**][281] (India’s tallest 24-floor hospital) and Hitech City(Main OPD, Cancer
Institute, Robotic Centre, Fertility Block, Emergency Unit), **Secunderabad**, **Chandanagar**,
**Women and Child Hitex Charminar**, **Nizamabad**, **Warangal**, **Karimnagar**.

In Andhra Pradesh, key locations include [**Visakhapatnam - MVP**][282] with 50+ specialties),
[**Medicover Cancer Institute**][283] (Arilova), **Women & Child Hospital (Jagadamba)**,
**Vizianagaram**, **Srikakulam**, **Nellore** & **Nellore Cancer Institute**, **Kakinada**, and
**Kurnool**.

In **Maharashtra**, Medicover operates advanced centers in **Navi Mumbai**, **Nashik**,
**Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar**, **Pune**, and **Sangamner**, ensuring accessible, high-quality
healthcare across India.

## Research and innovation

Our clinical research and innovation teams have one goal: to enable the best outcomes for our
patients by transforming healthcare through continuous improvements and revolutionary breakthroughs.

[Explore More][71]
* ### MedStar Health Research Institute
  
  Our research institute provides scientiﬁc, administrative, and regulatory support for clinical
  research throughout our system.
  
  Researchers work to advance the scientiﬁc understanding of disease and point the way toward better
  and more effective treatments.
  
  [Learn More][72]
* ### Institute for Innovation
  
  MedStar Institute for Innovation (MI2) creates a vibrant innovation ecosystem designed to
  transform care and advance health.
  
  Creative initiatives serve as a portal for new ideas and better practices--both from inside and
  outside of health care.
  
  [Learn More][73]
* ### Partnership with Georgetown University
  
  We are the medical education and clinical partner of Georgetown University, consistently ranked
  among the country's top universities. This partnership enables us to have one of the largest
  graduate medical education programs in the country.
  
  [Learn More][74]
* ### National Center for Human Factors in Healthcare
  
  The Center is an applied research, usability, safety advisement, and education center. We are
  committed to the scientific study of how humans think, work, and interact with the healthcare
  environment.
  
  The Center is the largest program of its kind embedded within a healthcare system in the U.S.
  
  [Learn More][75]
* ### Institute for Quality and Safety
  
  Through our Institute for Quality and Safety (MIQS), we improve patient care and healthcare
  outcomes.
  
  To achieve this, we bring together caregivers, patients, and family members to jointly develop,
  educate, assess, and advocate for patient safety and clinical quality initiatives.
  
  [Learn More][76]
* ### Simulation Training and Education Lab
  
  Our Simulation Training and Education Lab (SiTEL) is the innovative education technology group of
  MedStar Health.
  
  We specialize in hands-on simulation programs, learning technologies, clinical education, and
  learning research/design to drive better team performance and safer care for patients.
  
  [Learn More][77]
* ### International Training Center for Bloodless Medicine and Surgery
  
  Our mission is to improve quality of care and patient safety for Jehovah’s Witnesses by providing
  free training in the tools and techniques of bloodless medicine and surgery.
  
  [Learn More][78]

## Research and innovation

Our clinical research and innovation teams have one goal: to enable the best outcomes for our
patients by transforming healthcare through continuous improvements and revolutionary breakthroughs.

[Explore More][71]
* ### MedStar Health Research Institute
  
  Our research institute provides scientiﬁc, administrative, and regulatory support for clinical
  research throughout our system.
  
  Researchers work to advance the scientiﬁc understanding of disease and point the way toward better
  and more effective treatments.
  
  [Learn More][72]
* ### Institute for Innovation
  
  MedStar Institute for Innovation (MI2) creates a vibrant innovation ecosystem designed to
  transform care and advance health.
  
  Creative initiatives serve as a portal for new ideas and better practices--both from inside and
  outside of health care.
  
  [Learn More][73]
* ### Partnership with Georgetown University
  
  We are the medical education and clinical partner of Georgetown University, consistently ranked
  among the country's top universities. This partnership enables us to have one of the largest
  graduate medical education programs in the country.
  
  [Learn More][74]
* ### National Center for Human Factors in Healthcare
  
  The Center is an applied research, usability, safety advisement, and education center. We are
  committed to the scientific study of how humans think, work, and interact with the healthcare
  environment.
  
  The Center is the largest program of its kind embedded within a healthcare system in the U.S.
  
  [Learn More][75]
* ### Institute for Quality and Safety
  
  Through our Institute for Quality and Safety (MIQS), we improve patient care and healthcare
  outcomes.
  
  To achieve this, we bring together caregivers, patients, and family members to jointly develop,
  educate, assess, and advocate for patient safety and clinical quality initiatives.
  
  [Learn More][76]
* ### Simulation Training and Education Lab
  
  Our Simulation Training and Education Lab (SiTEL) is the innovative education technology group of
  MedStar Health.
  
  We specialize in hands-on simulation programs, learning technologies, clinical education, and
  learning research/design to drive better team performance and safer care for patients.
  
  [Learn More][77]
* ### International Training Center for Bloodless Medicine and Surgery
  
  Our mission is to improve quality of care and patient safety for Jehovah’s Witnesses by providing
  free training in the tools and techniques of bloodless medicine and surgery.
  
  [Learn More][78]

## Medical education programs

### For healthcare professionals

Together, our hospitals have one of the largest graduate medical education programs in the country.
We train 1,100 medical residents annually and offer advanced education in nearly 100 specialty and
sub-specialty programs.

[View All Medical Education Programs][79]

We have a strong partnership with Georgetown University, which is consistently ranked among the
country’s top universities. As an academic health system, MedStar Health and Georgetown University’s
shared mission is to transform health and advance health equity through our partnership of research
innovation, education expertise, compassionate care, and community collaboration.

## **Welcome to Mya Care**

Mya Care is a free online portal providing international solutions for all your health and wellness
needs. We take the stress out of searching for the right healthcare professionals, hospitals, and
treatment centers globally with our easy-to-use search engine. Enter your criteria, and we will help
you find a comprehensive range of healthcare providers from around the globe, including:
* Doctors
* Specialists
* Hospitals
* Clinics
* Alternative medicine
* Wellness spas
* Health and wellness centers

[Read More][102]

**Health and Wellness Simplified**

Mya Care’s online platform serves to empower its users by offering all the relevant information in
one place. Our aim is to expand your healthcare horizons through the power of simplicity, supplying
you with all you need to take charge of your health and wellbeing. Through making use of our
extensive database of medical treatments, healthcare services and world-class professionals, many
unnecessary hurdles to healthcare can be eliminated.

**Connecting people with professionals**

It would be a rare coincidence to find the perfect healthcare solution through reading health blogs
alone. Creating an ideal treatment plan calls for the integration of health information through the
lens of an expert – someone who is able to assist you in making wellness your day-to-day reality.

This is precisely why Mya Care puts users directly in contact with doctors and healthcare providers,
enabling patients to investigate their options on a more personal level. Ask your questions and
determine whether the location, facility and the specialists available suit your needs. You can also
access facility images, blogs, videos, physician profiles and detailed information on procedures,
all of which can be found in each provider’s clinical profile.

**For Patients**

Mya Care’s mission is to facilitate and empower individuals who are seeking ideal healthcare
solutions. Having the right details at the right time can make all the difference, especially when
the stakes are high. Users have free unlimited access to a comprehensive health resource as well as
a global network of expert healthcare professionals and providers, making it simpler now than ever
before to coordinate the perfect treatment plan.

**For Healthcare Providers and Doctors**

Join a global community of healthcare professionals today and expand your reach to more individuals
requiring your expertise.

We believe that better informed patients meet with better chances for successful treatment outcomes.
Through supplying users with all the relevant details, Mya Care saves time for physicians and
healthcare providers, while promoting their facilities and healthcare services to an international
audience. Medical professionals are encouraged to upload as much information as possible to the
platform. Providing clear and up-to-date information helps patients make informed decisions about
their treatment plans.

**A World of Choice**

Remain at the forefront of global medical innovation with Mya Care.

Healthcare is evolving on a daily basis due to enhanced global connectivity between international
medical institutes, healthcare providers and patients and Mya Care facilitates the process every
time new healthcare facilities and treatment centers join our database. Currently, the portal
features thousands of treatment options in a wide range of countries.

### Frequently Asked Questions

To learn more about how Mya Care works, please click to visit our Frequently Asked Questions Page

## **Welcome to Mya Care**

Mya Care is a free online portal providing international solutions for all your health and wellness
needs. We take the stress out of searching for the right healthcare professionals, hospitals, and
treatment centers globally with our easy-to-use search engine. Enter your criteria, and we will help
you find a comprehensive range of healthcare providers from around the globe, including:
* Doctors
* Specialists
* Hospitals
* Clinics
* Alternative medicine
* Wellness spas
* Health and wellness centers

[Read More][102]

**Health and Wellness Simplified**

Mya Care’s online platform serves to empower its users by offering all the relevant information in
one place. Our aim is to expand your healthcare horizons through the power of simplicity, supplying
you with all you need to take charge of your health and wellbeing. Through making use of our
extensive database of medical treatments, healthcare services and world-class professionals, many
unnecessary hurdles to healthcare can be eliminated.

**Connecting people with professionals**

It would be a rare coincidence to find the perfect healthcare solution through reading health blogs
alone. Creating an ideal treatment plan calls for the integration of health information through the
lens of an expert – someone who is able to assist you in making wellness your day-to-day reality.

This is precisely why Mya Care puts users directly in contact with doctors and healthcare providers,
enabling patients to investigate their options on a more personal level. Ask your questions and
determine whether the location, facility and the specialists available suit your needs. You can also
access facility images, blogs, videos, physician profiles and detailed information on procedures,
all of which can be found in each provider’s clinical profile.

**For Patients**

Mya Care’s mission is to facilitate and empower individuals who are seeking ideal healthcare
solutions. Having the right details at the right time can make all the difference, especially when
the stakes are high. Users have free unlimited access to a comprehensive health resource as well as
a global network of expert healthcare professionals and providers, making it simpler now than ever
before to coordinate the perfect treatment plan.

**For Healthcare Providers and Doctors**

Join a global community of healthcare professionals today and expand your reach to more individuals
requiring your expertise.

We believe that better informed patients meet with better chances for successful treatment outcomes.
Through supplying users with all the relevant details, Mya Care saves time for physicians and
healthcare providers, while promoting their facilities and healthcare services to an international
audience. Medical professionals are encouraged to upload as much information as possible to the
platform. Providing clear and up-to-date information helps patients make informed decisions about
their treatment plans.

**A World of Choice**

Remain at the forefront of global medical innovation with Mya Care.

Healthcare is evolving on a daily basis due to enhanced global connectivity between international
medical institutes, healthcare providers and patients and Mya Care facilitates the process every
time new healthcare facilities and treatment centers join our database. Currently, the portal
features thousands of treatment options in a wide range of countries.

13 Jun 2026 | Berita Harian [ Read Story ][157]
Patient Care 华人患遗传性林奇综合征概率较高 患癌风险增高
新加坡的基因分析发现，本地每530人中，会有一人患林奇综合征，华人的患病概率相对高，每420人就有一人。这
种遗传疾病会使患癌风险增高，但它没有直接症状，只能经由基因检测诊断。
13 Jun 2026 | Lianhe Zaobao [ Read Story ][158]
Patient Care 利用超声波震碎液化肝癌肿瘤 无创疗法为患者带来新希望
69岁的马哈慕德在确诊肝硬化两年后，发现肝脏长出1.6公分的肿瘤.
他原以为要饱受放疗或手术之苦来控制肿瘤，以争取时间等待肝移植，医生给了他另一选择，让他成为本地首几名
尝试崭新无创疗法的患者.
12 Jun 2026 | Lianhe Zaobao [ Read Story ][159]
Patient Care Ultrasound procedure for liver cancer saves grandfather’s place on transplant waiting
list Mahamood Ahamed, a grandfather of 12, almost had to give up his place on the waiting list for a
liver transplant. The 69-year-old was diagnosed with end-stage liver disease late in 2025.

### July is Vacation Time and UV Safety Month

It’s summertime - that means fun, sun, and vacations! Just because you are going through cancer
treatment doesn’t mean you can’t take a vacation. Watch the [Cancer Goes to the Beach][101] webinar
to get tips and resources to plan a safe and stress-free getaway. Wondering about [vacation while on
radiation treatment][102]? July is also UV Safety Month – learn all you need to know to [stay sun
safe][103] this summer.

treatment doesn’t mean you can’t take a vacation. Watch the [Cancer Goes to the Beach][101] webinar

radiation treatment][102]? July is also UV Safety Month – learn all you need to know to [stay sun

[ Learn more ][74]

precise, protective, and powerful cancer treatment.

## What is proton beam therapy?

Proton beam therapy is an advanced type of radiotherapy that uses highly charged particles to
deliver radiation to cancer cells, to stop them growing and spreading.

[Learn more][75]

Proton beam therapy targets tumours with greater precision than traditional radiotherapy, reducing
the risk of short and long-term side effects.

Proton beam therapy treatment sessions usually take around an hour, five days a week, for several

Proton beam therapy is suitable for treating cancer where precision is vital to avoid damage to

## **Frequently asked questions about proton beam cancer treatment**

### What are the risks of radiotherapy?

Radiotherapy is a well-researched and widely used cancer treatment, backed by decades of clinical
trials. However, because it works by damaging the DNA of cells, it can affect nearby healthy tissue,
resulting in side effects. The NHS and other leading healthcare providers take great care to
minimise these risks and provide comprehensive support to help manage any side effects.

Proton therapy can significantly reduce the risks of side effects by targeting tumours more
precisely, limiting radiation exposure to healthy tissue.

### How can I access proton beam therapy?

The treatment at Proton International London is available to insured and self-pay patients, both
from the UK and abroad. The NHS refers several hundred patients each year for treatment at The
Christie NHS Foundation Trust in Manchester and to clinics abroad. To explore your suitability for
PBT referral, discuss it with your care team and oncologist in the first instance. As a self-pay
patient from the UK or abroad, you can contact us at Proton International London to request a
consultation.

the most advanced technology available, allowing us to combine our expertise with exceptional
precision to treat your cancer.

[ Meet our consultant oncologists ][99]
[parent and child walking to proton therapy treatment]

### Thoughtful and personalised care

At Proton International London, we see *people*, not diagnoses. You and your family will become part
of our community. From your first contact to your final treatment, we’re here to support you with
compassion, clarity, and world-class care. Along with your consultant, you will be supported by a
team of radiographers, nurses, physicists, and care coordinators. We will be with you throughout the
course of your treatment to help you feel as comfortable, confident and informed as possible.

[ Meet our team ][100]
[International patients at Proton International London]

### Premium service

Whether travelling to us from within or outside the UK, you can expect outstanding service. The
frequency of proton therapy treatment can make it a logistical challenge, and we will do everything
we can to accommodate you and your family, including [**arranging luxury accommodation**][101] and
providing a personal interpreter if English is not your first language.

[ Our 5-star concierge service ][102]

## Your next steps

#### To ask a question or enquire about private treatment:

Please complete our [contact form][103] or call us on **[020 4629 3598][104]** **(9am to 10pm GMT
Mon-Fri)**. One of our friendly Patient Administration Advisors will be in touch as soon as
possible.

#### To refer yourself for proton beam therapy treatment:

Please fill out the [contact form][105] and select ‘**self-referral for a private consultation**’.
Kindly note that you will be asked to upload relevant medical documents to support your referral.

#### If you are an NHS patient seeking a referral:

Consult your care team and oncologist to discuss your suitability for proton therapy. Read more
about [getting a second opinion here][106].

## **Frequently asked questions about proton beam cancer treatment**

### What are the risks of radiotherapy?

Radiotherapy is a well-researched and widely used cancer treatment, backed by decades of clinical
trials. However, because it works by damaging the DNA of cells, it can affect nearby healthy tissue,
resulting in side effects. The NHS and other leading healthcare providers take great care to
minimise these risks and provide comprehensive support to help manage any side effects.

Proton therapy can significantly reduce the risks of side effects by targeting tumours more
precisely, limiting radiation exposure to healthy tissue.

### How can I access proton beam therapy?

The treatment at Proton International London is available to insured and self-pay patients, both
from the UK and abroad. The NHS refers several hundred patients each year for treatment at The
Christie NHS Foundation Trust in Manchester and to clinics abroad. To explore your suitability for
PBT referral, discuss it with your care team and oncologist in the first instance. As a self-pay
patient from the UK or abroad, you can contact us at Proton International London to request a
consultation.

Punarjan Ayurveda Hospitals believes in the ancient wisdom of Rasayana Ayurveda services. The
primary goal is to strengthen your body’s immune system with natural Rasayana formulations and plant
extracts. Punarjan Ayurveda Hospitals is the center of excellence for the comprehensive cancer care.
Its approach is rooted in the timeless wisdom of Ayurveda that has been helping us since millennia.
We guide people by providing proper counselling and proposing timely decisions about second
opinions. Most of our patients are happy with our treatment methods and feel satisfied in their
cancer journey.

With an extensive research of more than 2 decades, Punarjan Ayurveda Hospitals is here with with an
approach without pain and minimal other effects. Our research team at the hospital always looks for
new ways to make cancer care better.

It could be hard to deal cancer in its fourth stage, but Punarjan Ayurveda Hospitals tries to help
with these conditions. Affordable services are customized to each patient’s unique needs. This can
help you deal with the complications, helping you live a better life by complementing the
conventional approach.

#### **Integrative Cancer Care:**

Punarjan Ayurveda hospitals offers a wide range of services to make sure patients are relaxed and
well taken care of during their treatment care. Our new integrative process is unique and works
because it combines modern study with ancient Ayurvedic wisdom. Our main idea behind this treatment
process is Ayurveda Care to enhance immunity.

According to Punarjan Ayurveda Hospitals, extensive research is needed to improve cancer care. We
believe in complementary Ayurvedic Cancer Care.
 

Our focus is on treatment services that deal with some effects, such as pain, by following Ayurvedic
cancer care, making us stand out. We stay on the cutting edge of Ayurvedic care to enhance immunity
with evolving modern innovations.

Punarjan Ayurveda Hospitals stands out in providing excellent, affordable counselling services for
cancer care. Our individualized treatment plan, meticulously tailored to each patient, sets us
apart. Ayurvedic treatment services are believed to enhance immunity while enhancing the body’s
natural metabolism.

Our website is a testament to information on cancer care and its attributes. Its goal is to raise
awareness and improve patient satisfaction by helping patients choose treatment options. We at
Punarjan Ayurveda Hospitals offer offline and online consultations. Reaching out to our team for any
assistance is straightforward. Our team is always available to guide you if you have any questions
or concerns about how we treat you.

Emotional support is very intricate in cancer care. For that reason, we additionally provide
counseling services to support our patients. We understand that the cancer journey can sometimes
lead to hopelessness. Our patient counselors are here to assist you in overcoming emotional
obstacles.

Another important part of our treatment process is regular follow-up. We keep a close eye on the
patient’s progress to ensure the better outcomes. Our group stays in touch so that we can make any
necessary changes to your treatment plan.

A nutritionist’s help with our diet is integral to our cancer care. Because eating well can help
your body get stronger while you’re getting care, our experts can help you figure out the best way
with a customized diet plan.

Comprehensive Ayurvedic approach to Cancer care. Our targeted treatment care plans can enhance
overall immunity, and dedicated support services make us a trusted choice. Choose Punarjan Ayurveda
Hospitals for holistic and compassionate cancer care.

Sri. Bommu Venkateswara Reddy, who founded Punarjan Ayurveda Hospitals, had immense knowledge and
gained Ayurvedic wisdom from his more than twenty years plus of exploration in Rasyana Ayurvedic
cancer care. His main objective was to improve cancer patients’ lives while also helping those with
profound counselling services who couldn’t decide about treatment plans.

During this unique path, traditional Ayurveda science has a branch; Rasayana Ayurveda Services has
witnessed how it impacts the immune system and can assist and make it possible to help the chances
of cancer care. This Ayurvedic care of immunoenhancement offers a unique plan devised for
integrative cancer care. Integrated cancer services will greatly help people as this essence may
bring comfort during the cancer journey. Combining traditional ayurveda with modern approaches will
be a great attempt to furnish cancer services to the people to accomplish the dream of providing
top-notch counselling services to help cancer awareness among a wide section of people. A great team
is also a strength to his dream of rendering valuable services to bring quality of life in the
cancer care journey.

Sri. Bommu Venkateswara Reddy helps people in need. He has made it his goal throughout his work to
ensure that most people can access counselling services regarding cancer services so that proper
guidance will lead to timely decisions regarding cancer treatment services as part of a second

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's)

What is medical tourism, and how can it make my treatment journey easier?

Medical tourism refers to travelling abroad to receive medical treatment, accessing world-class
healthcare at more affordable costs. Sanjivani care simplifies this by handling everything from
medical visa invitation letter to post –treatment care, so you can focus entirely on your recovery.

Why should I choose SanjivaniCare for medical travel?

We assist with doctor selection, hospital coordination, visa support, travel planning, treatment
cost estimates, accommodation, language Interpreter, follow-up support, and assign a dedicated
patient care manager with each patient.

Which treatments and medical specialties can I access through SanjivaniCare?

Sanjivani Care partners with leading hospitals across specialties like Cardiology & Heart Surgery,
Oncology (Cancer treatment), Orthopaedics, Neurology & Neurosurgery, Paediatric procedures, IVF&
fertility, Cosmetic & Plastic surgery, Robotic procedures, Dental care, Organ transplant, Bariatric
surgery, General surgery, and CAR-T Cell therapy, matching you with the best specialists based on
your medical documents.

How does Sanjivani Care assist in selecting the right hospital and doctor for my treatment?

Our platform features detailed doctor profiles and comprehensive hospital pages, designed to help
you easily compare options and choose the best treatment with complete confidence.

What happens after I share my medical reports with SanjivaniCare, and how can I request an estimate
for my treatment costs?

Once you submit your enquiry and latest medical reports with our medical counsellors, they are
shared with 2–3 expert doctors who review them and create a personalized, cost-effective treatment
plan, including an estimated cost, within 48 hours.

Do I need a medical visa for treatment?

Yes, many countries request a Medical Visa for treatment. We assist with the required paperwork,
including visa documents, invitation letters, and hospital confirmations.

What payment options do international patients have?

Payments can be made directly to the hospital through a bank transfer before the patient travels, or
at the hospital payment counters in USD upon arrival. We do not collect money on behalf of the
hospital under any circumstances.

Are there any hidden charges?

No, there are no hidden charges. All expenses are explained in advance, and any extra procedures are
billed only if they are medically necessary.

Do you provide accommodation and travel support?

Yes, based on the patient’s request, we can arrange accommodation in hotels or guest houses, airport
pick-up and drop, language support, and local travel.

What if I don’t speak the local language?

 SanjivaniCare provides a professional language interpreter to assist you at every step. This helps
you communicate clearly with doctors and hospital staff. You can focus on your recovery without any
language barriers.

How does SanjivaniCare ensure my medical records and personal details stay completely private?

 SanjivaniCare ensures the privacy and confidentiality of your medical records by upholding strict
professional and ethical standards and following HIPAA-compliant data protection practices.

How many attendants are allowed with the patient during hospital treatment?

A maximum of 2-3 attendants are allowed with the patient during hospital treatment.

Does SanjivaniCare charge for its services, and are you part of the hospital?
