## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's)

What is medical tourism, and how can it make my treatment journey easier?

Medical tourism refers to travelling abroad to receive medical treatment, accessing world-class
healthcare at more affordable costs. Sanjivani care simplifies this by handling everything from
medical visa invitation letter to post –treatment care, so you can focus entirely on your recovery.

Why should I choose SanjivaniCare for medical travel?

We assist with doctor selection, hospital coordination, visa support, travel planning, treatment
cost estimates, accommodation, language Interpreter, follow-up support, and assign a dedicated
patient care manager with each patient.

Which treatments and medical specialties can I access through SanjivaniCare?

Sanjivani Care partners with leading hospitals across specialties like Cardiology & Heart Surgery,
Oncology (Cancer treatment), Orthopaedics, Neurology & Neurosurgery, Paediatric procedures, IVF&
fertility, Cosmetic & Plastic surgery, Robotic procedures, Dental care, Organ transplant, Bariatric
surgery, General surgery, and CAR-T Cell therapy, matching you with the best specialists based on
your medical documents.

How does Sanjivani Care assist in selecting the right hospital and doctor for my treatment?

Our platform features detailed doctor profiles and comprehensive hospital pages, designed to help
you easily compare options and choose the best treatment with complete confidence.

What happens after I share my medical reports with SanjivaniCare, and how can I request an estimate
for my treatment costs?

Once you submit your enquiry and latest medical reports with our medical counsellors, they are
shared with 2–3 expert doctors who review them and create a personalized, cost-effective treatment
plan, including an estimated cost, within 48 hours.

Do I need a medical visa for treatment?

Yes, many countries request a Medical Visa for treatment. We assist with the required paperwork,
including visa documents, invitation letters, and hospital confirmations.

What payment options do international patients have?

Payments can be made directly to the hospital through a bank transfer before the patient travels, or
at the hospital payment counters in USD upon arrival. We do not collect money on behalf of the
hospital under any circumstances.

Are there any hidden charges?

No, there are no hidden charges. All expenses are explained in advance, and any extra procedures are
billed only if they are medically necessary.

Do you provide accommodation and travel support?

Yes, based on the patient’s request, we can arrange accommodation in hotels or guest houses, airport
pick-up and drop, language support, and local travel.

What if I don’t speak the local language?

 SanjivaniCare provides a professional language interpreter to assist you at every step. This helps
you communicate clearly with doctors and hospital staff. You can focus on your recovery without any
language barriers.

How does SanjivaniCare ensure my medical records and personal details stay completely private?

 SanjivaniCare ensures the privacy and confidentiality of your medical records by upholding strict
professional and ethical standards and following HIPAA-compliant data protection practices.

How many attendants are allowed with the patient during hospital treatment?

A maximum of 2-3 attendants are allowed with the patient during hospital treatment.

Does SanjivaniCare charge for its services, and are you part of the hospital?

# Not everyone understands sarcoma. We do.

[Information about sarcoma][82] [Help and support][83][Get involved][84]

## Looking for answers

[

### You are not alone

We offer a range of support for **anyone** diagnosed with or concerned about sarcoma.

Find out more
][85]
[

### What is sarcoma?

Sarcomas are uncommon cancers that can affect any part of your body. **Here’s everything we know. **

Find out more
][86]
[

### Looking for answers

We fund **world-class science** to understand sarcoma better, improve treatments, and ultimately
**make a difference** to people’s lives.

Find out more
][87]
[

### Get involved

There are many ways for **you, your friends, your business or employer** to help us from fundraising
to campaigning to making a donation.

Find out more
][88]

## Sarcoma Awareness Month 2026: Life Goes On

This July, we are sharing real stories from people affected by sarcoma, showing that a diagnosis can
change a life, but it does not define it.

Meet the people behind this year’s campaign and help us raise awareness across the UK.

[Read the stories][89]

# Home

Home

Guiding patients to expert care and driving sarcoma research

[For Patients][47]
[For Researchers][48]

### Spotlight

July is Sarcoma Awareness Month, a time to shine a light on sarcomas that impact thousands of
children and adults each year. Throughout the month, SARC will share patient stories, research
advances, and ways to support ongoing clinical research.

 

#### June 25, 2026

[SARC041 Plenary Sesison at ASC0 2026]

## [SARC041 Named One of Five Practice-Changing Studies Selected for ASCO 2026 Plenary Presentation
## in Dedifferentiated Liposarcoma][49]

SARC041 highlighted at ASCO 2026 during Plenary Session


[Sweat Away Sarcoma Logo]

## [Join Us for the Second Annual Sweat Away Sarcoma HYROX Charity Event][50]

Join us for the Second Annual Sweat Away Sarcoma HYROX Charity Event on Saturday, July 11, 2026.

[More SARC News][51]

 


## INVESTED IN RESEARCH
## SINCE OUR FOUNDING

## 24 COMPLETED / 6 ACTIVE /

## JOURNALS

[**Read about SARC research »**][54]

* Nov 18
* 2026
* ### [2026 SARC Semiannual Meeting as Part of CTOS][55]
* 3:00 - 5:00 pm local time
* Coex Convention Center in Seoul, South Korea

[LEARN MORE][56]



## PATIENT RESOURCES

[yellow ribbon]

We understand that finding experienced sarcoma care without delay is the one of the biggest
challenges for sarcoma patients and their families. 

[FIND EXPERT HELP][57]

## COLLABORATING TO CURE SARCOMA

Founded in 2003 as a non-profit sarcoma cancer research organization, we lead domestic and
international collaborative discovery, translational research, and clinical trials.

[ABOUT SARC][58]

## RESOURCES FOR RESEARCHERS

SARC is one of the few organizations focusing on all types of sarcoma. We have the unique ability to
promote collaboration and unity among the leading sarcoma researchers.

[FIND RESOURCES][59]

## PARTNER WITH SARC

[animated gif of supporter logos]

We collaborate with the scientific research community and partner with pharmaceutical and biotech
companies bringing SARC’s unique insights, experience, and network to the table.

[LEARN ABOUT OPPORTUNITIES][60]

#### Join OUR community

Stay up-to-date on clinical trials and learn from our team of sarcoma experts.
* [ ][61]

## About Sarc

SARC (Sarcoma Alliance for Research through Collaboration) is a U.S.-based 501 (c)(3) non-profit
cancer research organization dedicated to the development and support of research for the
prevention, treatment, and cure of sarcoma – a cancer of the bone and connective tissues of the
body.

P.O. Box 406 | Ann Arbor, MI 48106
+1-734-930-7600 | +1-734-930-7557 fax | [sarc@sarctrials.org][62]

[INDUSTRY][67]**

© 2026 Sarcoma Alliance For Research Through Collaboration

[ [NCI MyPART] ][68]
[ Back to top][69]

## Stay in touch

We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the confidentiality of those who use our web
site or interact with us online. SARC does not share, sell, or exchange any information about
visitors, donors, newsletter recipients, nor our constituents with any third party.

## FAQs

**How can social networking benefit physicians?**

As a physician, being up-to-date on today’s medical news is essential; but remaining on the
cutting-edge of the medical world is not easy. A social network for doctors like Sermo can help
empower physicians across [medical specialties][46] to achieve their personal and professional
goals, while having fun and making meaningful connections with others.

Sermo is the only dedicated social network for doctors in the world—bringing together more than
1,000,000 triple-verified physicians, who are looking for and sharing the latest medical insights.
By joining Sermo, you can improve your medical practice and grow your professional network.

Sermo gives you access to the latest medical news so you can read, collaborate, and discuss with
your fellow professionals. The easy-to-use platform provides access to exclusive content, while
helping you keep a pulse on the latest happenings in the medical world.

The popularity of social media by physicians had been steadily and consistently growing; but in
2020—as COVID-19 completely changed the way the world communicated—the number of physicians engaging
in social media grew exponentially. Sermo experienced an 83% increase in global unique logins on its
platform alone—and a 24% increase in time spent on the site.

When physicians were asked to compare physician-only social platforms against general social media,
they said physician-only platforms offered more credibility, security, privacy, value of
information, and allowed a better connectivity with peers.

*“Sermo is an excellent tool for connecting colleagues and often helps us share our experiences and
clarify diagnostic and therapeutic doubts.”* —Sermo Member, Orthopedic Surgeon

The top 3 reasons physicians use social media professionally across all markets are:

1. Staying up to date on medical news.
2. Connecting with peers.
3. Sharing knowledge.

There’s a reason that Sermo is the number one social network for doctors, and rapidly growing. The
community is designed to help you be the best physician you can be, by providing access to thousands
of patient cases and the largest [drug ratings][47] database in the world—featuring over 1.2+
million ratings! With Sermo, you can give your patients a superior standard of care, while growing
your professional network and taking your practice to the next level.

In addition to its physician-only network, Sermo now offers exclusive, separate communities for APPs
(nurse practitioners and physician associates) and for Pharmacists. These dedicated spaces provide
tailored experiences where members can collaborate, learn, and connect with peers who understand
their unique roles in healthcare—while still enjoying access to earning opportunities through paid
medical surveys.

**How can doctors use social networking sites like Sermo?**

Social media has become an essential tool for doctors to connect with patients, colleagues, and the
wider healthcare community. By leveraging social media effectively, doctors can enhance their
practice, improve patient care, and stay informed about advancements in the medical field. So it is
important for doctors to not only maintain a professional presence on social media but also use it
as a valuable resource for their profession. With proper use of privacy settings and adhering to
ethical guidelines, doctors can leverage social media to benefit both themselves and their patients.

Some of the key benefits of using social media for doctors include building a strong online
presence, sharing valuable health information, connecting with colleagues and peers, promoting their
practice, and staying updated on industry news and developments.

**– Sharing valuable health information:** social media can also be a powerful tool for doctors to
share valuable health information and educate their patients. Through blog posts, infographics,
videos, and other visual content, doctors can inform their followers about various health topics,
offer tips for maintaining good health, and dispel any myths or misconceptions.
– **Connecting with colleagues and peers:** social media provides a professional networking
opportunity for doctors to connect with colleagues and peers from all over the world. By joining
online communities or participating in discussions on social networking sites like Sermo and
LinkedIn, doctors can exchange knowledge and insights with fellow healthcare professionals. This not
only helps them stay updated on current medical practices but also allows them to collaborate on
research projects or refer patients to specialists.
**– Promoting their practice:** social media can be an effective marketing tool for doctors to
promote their practice and attract new patients. By sharing positive patient reviews,
before-and-after photos, or success stories on professional networking platforms, doctors can build
trust and credibility among their followers. This can ultimately lead to more referrals and
appointments.
**– Staying updated on industry news and development:** finally, social media allows doctors to stay
updated on industry news and developments in real-time. Many healthcare organizations, medical
journals, and professional networking associations have a presence on social media where they share
the latest research findings, updates on medical technology, policy changes, and other important
information that may impact a doctor’s practice.

Social media has revolutionized the way we communicate and connect with others, and doctors are no
exception. With the right approach and understanding, social media can be a powerful tool for
doctors to build their online presence, educate patients, connect with colleagues, promote their
practice, and stay updated on industry news and developments. By incorporating social media into
their professional lives, doctors can improve patient care and contribute to the advancement of
healthcare as a whole. [HCPs can try Sermo out today for free][48] – you might be surprised at what
you learn!

**How can doctors maintain patient confidentiality while using social media?**

Social media has become an integral part of our daily lives, including in the medical field. Doctors
can use social media to enhance their practice, connect with colleagues and patients, and stay
informed about the latest developments in healthcare. However, it is crucial for doctors to approach
social media with a clear understanding of its benefits and risks. By leveraging social media
responsibly, physicians can foster meaningful connections, educate their audience, and promote a
more informed and engaged patient community.

Doctors should always remember that while using social media, they are still bound by the same
ethical standards as in face-to-face interactions with patients. This means maintaining patient
confidentiality and respecting boundaries at all times. Additionally, doctors should be cautious
about sharing personal opinions

## FAQs

**How can social networking benefit physicians?**

As a physician, being up-to-date on today’s medical news is essential; but remaining on the
cutting-edge of the medical world is not easy. A social network for doctors like Sermo can help
empower physicians across [medical specialties][46] to achieve their personal and professional
goals, while having fun and making meaningful connections with others.

Sermo is the only dedicated social network for doctors in the world—bringing together more than
1,000,000 triple-verified physicians, who are looking for and sharing the latest medical insights.
By joining Sermo, you can improve your medical practice and grow your professional network.

Sermo gives you access to the latest medical news so you can read, collaborate, and discuss with
your fellow professionals. The easy-to-use platform provides access to exclusive content, while
helping you keep a pulse on the latest happenings in the medical world.

The popularity of social media by physicians had been steadily and consistently growing; but in
2020—as COVID-19 completely changed the way the world communicated—the number of physicians engaging
in social media grew exponentially. Sermo experienced an 83% increase in global unique logins on its
platform alone—and a 24% increase in time spent on the site.

When physicians were asked to compare physician-only social platforms against general social media,
they said physician-only platforms offered more credibility, security, privacy, value of
information, and allowed a better connectivity with peers.

*“Sermo is an excellent tool for connecting colleagues and often helps us share our experiences and
clarify diagnostic and therapeutic doubts.”* —Sermo Member, Orthopedic Surgeon

The top 3 reasons physicians use social media professionally across all markets are:

1. Staying up to date on medical news.
2. Connecting with peers.
3. Sharing knowledge.

There’s a reason that Sermo is the number one social network for doctors, and rapidly growing. The
community is designed to help you be the best physician you can be, by providing access to thousands
of patient cases and the largest [drug ratings][47] database in the world—featuring over 1.2+
million ratings! With Sermo, you can give your patients a superior standard of care, while growing
your professional network and taking your practice to the next level.

In addition to its physician-only network, Sermo now offers exclusive, separate communities for APPs
(nurse practitioners and physician associates) and for Pharmacists. These dedicated spaces provide
tailored experiences where members can collaborate, learn, and connect with peers who understand
their unique roles in healthcare—while still enjoying access to earning opportunities through paid
medical surveys.

**How can doctors use social networking sites like Sermo?**

Social media has become an essential tool for doctors to connect with patients, colleagues, and the
wider healthcare community. By leveraging social media effectively, doctors can enhance their
practice, improve patient care, and stay informed about advancements in the medical field. So it is
important for doctors to not only maintain a professional presence on social media but also use it
as a valuable resource for their profession. With proper use of privacy settings and adhering to
ethical guidelines, doctors can leverage social media to benefit both themselves and their patients.

Some of the key benefits of using social media for doctors include building a strong online
presence, sharing valuable health information, connecting with colleagues and peers, promoting their
practice, and staying updated on industry news and developments.

**– Sharing valuable health information:** social media can also be a powerful tool for doctors to
share valuable health information and educate their patients. Through blog posts, infographics,
videos, and other visual content, doctors can inform their followers about various health topics,
offer tips for maintaining good health, and dispel any myths or misconceptions.
– **Connecting with colleagues and peers:** social media provides a professional networking
opportunity for doctors to connect with colleagues and peers from all over the world. By joining
online communities or participating in discussions on social networking sites like Sermo and
LinkedIn, doctors can exchange knowledge and insights with fellow healthcare professionals. This not
only helps them stay updated on current medical practices but also allows them to collaborate on
research projects or refer patients to specialists.
**– Promoting their practice:** social media can be an effective marketing tool for doctors to
promote their practice and attract new patients. By sharing positive patient reviews,
before-and-after photos, or success stories on professional networking platforms, doctors can build
trust and credibility among their followers. This can ultimately lead to more referrals and
appointments.
**– Staying updated on industry news and development:** finally, social media allows doctors to stay
updated on industry news and developments in real-time. Many healthcare organizations, medical
journals, and professional networking associations have a presence on social media where they share
the latest research findings, updates on medical technology, policy changes, and other important
information that may impact a doctor’s practice.

Social media has revolutionized the way we communicate and connect with others, and doctors are no
exception. With the right approach and understanding, social media can be a powerful tool for
doctors to build their online presence, educate patients, connect with colleagues, promote their
practice, and stay updated on industry news and developments. By incorporating social media into
their professional lives, doctors can improve patient care and contribute to the advancement of
healthcare as a whole. [HCPs can try Sermo out today for free][48] – you might be surprised at what
you learn!

**How can doctors maintain patient confidentiality while using social media?**

Social media has become an integral part of our daily lives, including in the medical field. Doctors
can use social media to enhance their practice, connect with colleagues and patients, and stay
informed about the latest developments in healthcare. However, it is crucial for doctors to approach
social media with a clear understanding of its benefits and risks. By leveraging social media
responsibly, physicians can foster meaningful connections, educate their audience, and promote a
more informed and engaged patient community.

Doctors should always remember that while using social media, they are still bound by the same
ethical standards as in face-to-face interactions with patients. This means maintaining patient
confidentiality and respecting boundaries at all times. Additionally, doctors should be cautious
about sharing personal opinions

# Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Treat cancer as a fungus
[dr tullio simoncini]

#### Dr. Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Dr. Tullio Simoncini, – oncologist from Rome, Italy – has pioneered sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3)
therapy as a means to treat cancer. The fundamental theory behind this treatment lies in the fact
that, despite a number of variable factors, the formation and spreading of tumors is simply the
result of the presence of a fungus.

[more][7]
[simoncini sodium bicarbonate iv]

#### Sodium Bicarbonate

Sodium bicarbonate, unlike other anti-fungal remedies to which the fungus can become immune, is
extremely diffusible and retains its ability to penetrate the tumor, due to the speed at which the
sodium bicarbonate disintegrates the tumor. This speed makes fungi’s adaptability impossible,
rendering it defenseless.

[more][8]

## General information

[dr tulklio simoncini rome italy]

#### About Dr. Simoncini

Tullio Simoncini is a roman doctor specialising in oncology, diabetology and in metabolic disorders.
He has a strong opposition to any type of intellectual conformity, which is often based on
suppositions without foundation or worse, on lies and falsities.

[sodium bicarbonate IV solution]

#### Sodium bicarbonate

The fundamental reason and the motives that suggest a therapy with sodium bicarbonate against
tumours is that, although with the concurrence of a myriad of variable concausal factors – the
development and the local and remote proliferation of these tumours has a cause that is exclusively
fungin.

[candida albicans]

#### Candida Albicans

Candida in cancer patients is usually interpreted as a consequence of the weakening and of the
exhaustion of the organism because of neoplastic lesions. But candida is not a post hoc but an ante
hoc cause.

[treatment-protocols]

#### Treatment protocols

Dr. Simoncini’s methods have cured people for over 25 years. Many of his patients recovered
completely from cancer, even in cases where official oncology had given up.
The best way to try to eliminate a tumour is to bring it into contact with sodium bicarbonate, as
closely as possible.

# Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Treat cancer as a fungus
[dr tullio simoncini]

#### Dr. Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Dr. Tullio Simoncini, – oncologist from Rome, Italy – has pioneered sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3)
therapy as a means to treat cancer. The fundamental theory behind this treatment lies in the fact
that, despite a number of variable factors, the formation and spreading of tumors is simply the
result of the presence of a fungus.

[more][7]
[simoncini sodium bicarbonate iv]

#### Sodium Bicarbonate

Sodium bicarbonate, unlike other anti-fungal remedies to which the fungus can become immune, is
extremely diffusible and retains its ability to penetrate the tumor, due to the speed at which the
sodium bicarbonate disintegrates the tumor. This speed makes fungi’s adaptability impossible,
rendering it defenseless.

[more][8]

## General information

[dr tulklio simoncini rome italy]

#### About Dr. Simoncini

Tullio Simoncini is a roman doctor specialising in oncology, diabetology and in metabolic disorders.
He has a strong opposition to any type of intellectual conformity, which is often based on
suppositions without foundation or worse, on lies and falsities.

[sodium bicarbonate IV solution]

#### Sodium bicarbonate

The fundamental reason and the motives that suggest a therapy with sodium bicarbonate against
tumours is that, although with the concurrence of a myriad of variable concausal factors – the
development and the local and remote proliferation of these tumours has a cause that is exclusively
fungin.

[candida albicans]

#### Candida Albicans

Candida in cancer patients is usually interpreted as a consequence of the weakening and of the
exhaustion of the organism because of neoplastic lesions. But candida is not a post hoc but an ante
hoc cause.

[treatment-protocols]

#### Treatment protocols

Dr. Simoncini’s methods have cured people for over 25 years. Many of his patients recovered
completely from cancer, even in cases where official oncology had given up.
The best way to try to eliminate a tumour is to bring it into contact with sodium bicarbonate, as
closely as possible.

At Texas Oncology, we're committed to making your cancer care experience as supportive and
empowering as possible.


Our team of compassionate, highly trained oncologists provides comprehensive treatment options
tailored to your individual needs. Whether you're undergoing chemotherapy, radiation, or other
therapies, we’re here to guide you with expertise, respect, and care — every step of the way.

‌

[[Texas Oncology banner image featuring a smiling older male patient holding a cane while a
healthcare provider in blue scrubs places a reassuring hand on his shoulder, conveying compassionate
patient care, with a blue overlay on the left side of the image]][11]
[About Texas Oncology][12]

Texas Oncology’s mission is to provide evidence-based and high-quality care to each patient we
serve, while advancing cancer care for tomorrow.

‌

[[Texas Oncology banner image featuring a smiling young female cancer patient seated across from her
physician at a consultation table, with a clipboard nearby, conveying compassionate and personalized
cancer care, with a blue overlay on the left side of the image]][13]
[Cancer Care][14]

Texas Oncology helps patients navigate their cancer journeys with a highly-skilled care team
featuring physicians, advanced practice providers, pharmacists, and social workers.

‌

[[Texas Oncology banner image featuring a focused female researcher in a white lab coat, safety
goggles, and stethoscope working in a laboratory setting, with a deep blue overlay on the left side
of the image]][15]
[Clinical Trials][16]

Texas Oncology is a leader in groundbreaking cancer research and clinical trials in Texas, paving
the way for new breakthroughs in cancer care.

## Our Specialty Programs

Specialty

### [Medical Oncology][17]

Our medical oncology team specializes in diagnosis, personalized treatment planning, and coordinated
care to support you every step of the way.
Specialty

### [Radiation Oncology][18]

Targeted radiation therapy tailored to your goals for effective, precise cancer care.
Specialty

### [Hematology][19]

Comprehensive care for blood cancers and disorders—anemia, leukemia, and clotting—personalized
treatment close to home.
Specialty

### [Breast Care][20]

Texas Breast Specialists is a group of physicians dedicated to diagnosing and treating diseases and
disorders of the breast – both cancerous and benign.
Specialty

### [Colorectal Care][21]

The surgeons of Texas Colon & Rectal Specialists offer advanced screening, diagnosis, and treatment
for colon and rectal conditions, improving health and quality of life.
Specialty

### [Urology][22]

The physicians of Texas Urology Specialists offer compassionate and comprehensive urology care and
advanced treatments for a wide range of urologic conditions.
Specialty

### [Surgical Oncology][23]

Texas Oncology Surgical Specialists offers comprehensive cancer surgery—biopsies, tumor removal, and
minimally invasive options from skilled surgical oncologists.
Specialty

### [Gynecologic Oncology][24]

Compassionate, advanced surgery and care for ovarian, uterine, cervical, and vulvar cancers.
Specialty

### [Proton Therapy][25]

Targeted proton therapy delivers powerful cancer treatment with fewer side effects—close to home at
Texas Oncology.
[Exterior of a Texas Oncology clinic location at 9750 Hillwood Parkway, featuring a modern building
with large glass windows, wood panel accents, and the Texas Oncology logo displayed prominently on
the stone facade, surrounded by native ornamental grasses under a partly cloudy sky]
We make it as easy as possible to access the care you need. With more than 250 locations, you are
likely to find a provider near where you live and work.
[Find care near you
][26]

### A Mother and Son’s Journey to Overcoming Hodgkin’s Lymphoma

Michelle Prescott, a mother of five based in Conroe, Texas, wasn’t one to visit the doctor for minor
health issues, but one afternoon in December 2019, something was off.

[Read More

Colon Cancer

trial that helped her regain strength and fight back.

][30]

Head and Neck Cancer

### [Colorectal Care][21]

The surgeons of Texas Colon & Rectal Specialists offer advanced screening, diagnosis, and treatment
for colon and rectal conditions, improving health and quality of life.
Specialty

### [Urology][22]

The physicians of Texas Urology Specialists offer compassionate and comprehensive urology care and
advanced treatments for a wide range of urologic conditions.
Specialty

### [Surgical Oncology][23]

Texas Oncology Surgical Specialists offers comprehensive cancer surgery—biopsies, tumor removal, and
minimally invasive options from skilled surgical oncologists.
Specialty

### [Gynecologic Oncology][24]

Compassionate, advanced surgery and care for ovarian, uterine, cervical, and vulvar cancers.
Specialty

### [Proton Therapy][25]

Targeted proton therapy delivers powerful cancer treatment with fewer side effects—close to home at
Texas Oncology.
[Exterior of a Texas Oncology clinic location at 9750 Hillwood Parkway, featuring a modern building
with large glass windows, wood panel accents, and the Texas Oncology logo displayed prominently on
the stone facade, surrounded by native ornamental grasses under a partly cloudy sky]
We make it as easy as possible to access the care you need. With more than 250 locations, you are
likely to find a provider near where you live and work.
[Find care near you

# Dependable medical supply support for Indian health organizations.

Tribal Innovations is a Native-owned medical-supply distributor helping Indian Health Service
facilities, tribal healthcare programs, and urban Indian health organizations access the products
they need with responsive, relationship-first service.

[Request a quote][8][View product categories][9]

Why Tribal Innovations

## Native ownership, workflow capability, and fulfillment depth — together

Tribal Innovations combines Native-owned positioning with the operational capability and supply
depth to actually deliver — making us a more credible partner for Indian health organizations.

### Native-owned and procurement-aligned

Built to serve Indian Health Service facilities, tribally operated healthcare programs, and urban
Indian health organizations through a Native-owned business model.

### Workflow capability that supports execution

Tribal’s model is designed to help manage invoicing, account coordination, and the practical steps
required to move orders forward.

### Supply depth through a national partner

The company’s operating model combines community alignment with broader fulfillment infrastructure,
helping reduce the gap between access and reliable delivery.

Who We Serve

## Supporting the organizations at the heart of Indian health procurement

### Indian Health Service facilities

Reliable medical-supply support for Indian health operations.

### Tribally operated healthcare programs

Responsive service built for the way tribal healthcare programs work.

### Urban Indian health organizations

Dependable product access through a Native-owned partner.

[Cardinal Health — authorized distributor partner of Tribal Innovations]

Supply Partnership

## Authorized distributor partner of Cardinal Health

A recurring challenge in this market is vendors who win contracts but lack the supply depth to
fulfill reliably. Tribal Innovations addresses this directly: as an authorized Cardinal Health
distributor, customers get access to Cardinal's full product catalog and fulfillment infrastructure
— through a Native-owned partner.

Access to Cardinal Health's full medical-supply catalog

Reliable fulfillment through an established national supply network

Native-owned positioning without sacrificing product depth or reliability

What We Bring

## Built to deliver, not just to win the contract

Indian health procurement rewards vendors who show up reliably over time. Tribal Innovations is
built around the capabilities that make that possible.

Authorized Cardinal Health distributor — access to a broad national catalog, not a thin sourcing
list.

Native-owned positioning aligned with Indian health procurement pathways and preference programs.

Invoicing and billing support designed for Indian health settings, including coordination with
government payment workflows.

Direct, responsive account management — a real relationship, not a ticketing system.

A fulfillment model built for reliability, so the order that gets placed is the order that arrives.

Family Leadership

## Rooted in Jemez Pueblo, built for the long term

Tribal Innovations is led by a family with deep community roots in Jemez Pueblo and a clear
commitment to service, trust, and long-term follow-through.

[Meet the leadership team][10]
[Allen Gachupin]

### Allen Gachupin

President

Allen Gachupin founded Tribal Innovations and serves as President, leading the company with a
philosophy grounded in service, character, and accountability. A proud Jemez Pueblo tribal member
and U.S. Army veteran, he has dedicated his career to community leadership and building lasting
relationships.

[Kai Gachupin]

### Kai Gachupin

CEO

Kai Gachupin serves as CEO of Tribal Innovations, bringing more than two decades of experience
leading Native-owned businesses in energy, distribution, and government contracting. A proud Jemez
Pueblo tribal member, he leads company strategy and customer development with a long-term focus on
service and reliability.

Start the Relationship

## Ready to work together?

Reach out to Tribal Innovations to discuss your procurement environment, supply needs, or the kind
of relationship you want to build.

[Request a quote][11]
[Tribal Innovations logo]

Tribal Innovations LLC

Native-owned medical supply distribution

Tribal Innovations is building a grounded, relationship-first model for serving Indian health
procurement with dependable operational support, invoicing workflows, and fulfillment coordination.

Our Relentless Pursuit of Healing

[A black woman, smiling at a desk that has flowers and a pride flag displayed on it.]
Awards and Recognitions

### [ Our New Recognition as a Healthcare Equality Leader ][154]

UMass Memorial earns recognition as an LGBTQ+ Healthcare Equality Leader, demonstrating its
commitment to inclusive, high-quality care for all.

[ Learn More about Our New Recognition as a Healthcare Equality Leader ][155]
[A little girl high-fives the doctor in Urgent Care having had her ankle bandaged and a bad scrape
treated.]
Services-Treatments

### [ Urgent Care When You Need It - Seven Days a Week ][156]

Summer happens — bites, burns, scrapes and all. Get expert care fast at a convenient UMass Memorial
Health urgent care location. On-site X-ray and labs are available.

 

[ Learn More about Urgent Care When You Need It - Seven Days a Week ][157]
[A woman waves hello to a group of people in an online meeting.]
7.20.26 | Support Groups

### [ Virtual Patient and Family Cancer Support Group ][158]

Join us on Monday, July 20, with special guest Carisa Lozoraitis, Cancer Quality Program Manager at
the Medical Center. We will have an open discussion, share information, and exchange experiences.

[ Learn More about Virtual Patient and Family Cancer Support Group ][159]
[A CRNA in an operating room, smiling and looking at the camera.]
Careers

### [ We’re Hiring CRNAs ][160]

Join our team of outstanding CRNAs. We’ll offer you a strong and supportive culture, flexible
schedules, career growth opportunities and great benefits.

[ Learn More about We’re Hiring CRNAs ][161]

## Our System of Care

UMass Memorial Health is the health and wellness partner of the people of Central Massachusetts and
beyond. Our health system is made up of five hospitals, including a children’s medical center,
behavioral health services and a dedicated provider group.
